facts_used.fact: Plain TJA1051 (pin 5 n.c.): VIO and EN are internally connected to VCC.
TXD and S VIH min = 0.7 x VIO; for plain TJA1051 that is 0.7 x VCC = 3.5 V at VCC = 5 V.
RXD HIGH level is referenced to VIO (= VCC on plain TJA1051), i.e. ~5 V; ESP32 GPIO is a 3.3 V domain.

Pin 5 left open: n.c. variant no effect; VIO variant -> undervoltage, Off mode, passive to bus; EN variant -> Normal/Silent not selectable. Open pin 5 is electrically fail-safe for every variant, but reception works only if pin 5 is n.c.
S open -> Silent mode not selectable (S has internal pull-down). An explicit pull-up is therefore mandatory for Silent.
VCC 4.5-5.5 V; local 47-100 nF decoupling; ~10 uF regulator buffer for TJA1051 at 500 kbit/s.
Bus-end nodes use split termination 2 x 60 ohm + 4.7 nF; optional 100 pF on CANH/CANL; stub nodes unterminated or weak.
Absolute maximum on TXD, RXD, S: -0.3 V to +7 V.

open_items: Continuity-check NodeMCU-32S header pins 33 (GPIO21), 36 (GPIO22), 38 (GND) against the physical board.
Confirm SO8 pin-1 orientation of the marked U1 before soldering.
Confirm the pin-5 function of the installed U1 (n.c., VIO or EN). Rev B receives only if pin 5 is n.c.; with VIO/EN it stays safely passive but receives nothing.
Measure +5V_CAN within 4.5-5.5 V and RXD_3V3 <= 3.6 V with U1 powered and bus idle before connecting GPIO22.
Bench capture needs a third, ACKing CAN node because U1 is Silent and the TWAI controller is listen-only.
Import civic-workbench-rev-b-sim.edf in a licensed Proteus 9.2, save the .pdsprj and record the simulation run.
